name: rizin-re-toolkit
description: Default native reverse engineering and dump analysis toolkit, routing Ghidra/IDA-style workflows through portable Rizin.

interface.shortDescription: Native RE, decompilation, and dump analysis.
interface.longDescription: The default entrypoint for native reverse engineering, including Ghidra, IDA, Hex-Rays, Binary Ninja, Cutter, and radare2-style requests. Routes equivalent binary and dump analysis through portable Rizin, bundled RetDec/Ghidra/jsdec, YARA, and FLIRT. Downloads the verified Windows x64 CLI from GitHub Releases when needed.
defaultPrompt: Use Rizin RE Toolkit to analyze this binary or memory dump.
